description: Searches one mailbox folder by sender, recipient, subject, words in the message, date range or read status. Results are newest first.

account.description: Which mailbox to use, by its name or email address. Configured: none configured yet. Required when more than one is set up.

before.description: Before this date (same formats as since).

folder.description: Folder to look in. Defaults to the inbox. Accepts "inbox", "sent", "drafts", "trash", "spam", "archive" or an exact folder name from list_folders.

from.description: Sender name or address contains this text.

include_previews.description: Include a short preview of each message. Turn off for faster large searches.

since.description: On or after this date: "today", "yesterday", "30d" or 2026-10-01.

name: search_emails
title: Search emails
